arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Familiars{/c} apply effects around them every {c_number}[{SF_19}|1|]{/c} seconds according to their Element:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Fire{/c}: Applies {c_number}{DOT:BURNING}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} seconds to enemies.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Cold{/c}: Applies {c_number}[SF_8|%|]{/c} Chill to enemies.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_label}Lightning{/c}: Stuns enemies for {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} second.

Casting {c_important}Familiar{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_35]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} and restores {c_number}[SF_36 * 100 |1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life ({c_number}[{heal:HEAL_TOOLTIP}|0|]{/c}) per second while active.

{c_important}Familiar{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

{c_important}Familiar{/c} increases your Minimum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} by {c_number}[SF_37]{/c} and grants {c_number}[SF_38 * 100|2%|]{/c} Cooldown Reduction while active.

{c_important}Familiar{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

{c_important}Familiar{/c} {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_40|%|]{/c} and {c_important}{u}Weakens{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}[SF_39]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Familiar{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c}, {c_important}Shock{/c}, and {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that summons a stationary {c_important}Prismatic Familiar{/c}.

Casting Skills will cause {c_important}Prismatic Familiar{/c} to apply {c_number}{dot:UPGRADED_BURN}{/c} Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADED_BURN}{/c} seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.

Gain a bonus based on the {c_important}Familiar{/c} type when the {c_important}Familiar{/c} explodes:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Fire Familiar{/c} {icon:arrow,1.2} Gain {if:SF_33}{c_number}[SF_6 * 100|1%+|]{/c}{else}{c_number}[SF_6 * 100|%+|]{/c}{/if} Healing Received for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Cold Familiar{/c} {icon:arrow,1.2} Gain a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_7*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_7]){/c} for {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[SF_9 * 100|%|]{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Lightning Familiar{/c} {icon:arrow,1.2} Reduce a random active Cooldown by {c_number}[SF_10|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
